Federal Parliament
House of Representatives, 2082
Second Session
Meeting Number - 22
Federal Parliament of Nepal
Daily Business Schedule
Friday, Jeth 29, 2083
11:00 AM
Management Work
1. Honorable Finance Minister Dr. Swarnim Wagle will present the proposal to "Consider the Appropriation Bill, 2083".
2. Honorable Minister for Culture, Tourism and Civil Aviation Khadak Raj Poudel will present the proposal to "Consider the Intangible Cultural Heritage (Protection) Bill, 2083" originating in the National Assembly.
3. Honorable Minister for Industry, Commerce and Supplies, who also holds the portfolio of Honorable Minister for Youth, Labour and Employment, Gauri Kumari will:
(a) Present the "International Labour Organization Convention on Labour Inspection, 1947 No. 81".
(b) Present the "Protocol of 2014 to the International Labour Organization Convention concerning Forced Labour, 1930 No. 29".
Pada Prasad Pandey
Secretary-General
